name: Instagram follow — the press beat
description: Creator platform block (brief: instagram-follow): a pack-immune, platform-faithful Instagram profile card over transparent footage — story-ring avatar, username, meta — whose blue Follow button presses to Following at the 0.42 beat. One Preset reflows from a vertical bottom-center action band to a horizontal bottom-left CTA through an explicit orientation placement override. Faithful artifact per ADR-0038: the Instagram gradient/blue consume no Pack roles and render pixel-identical under every Pack. A derived pop cue fires at the press; the footage keeps its own audio otherwise.
